title: Spaces
intro: Members create and run spaces. The owner decides who can post.
empty: No spaces yet. Start the first one.
loadFailed: We couldn’t load the spaces. Try again in a moment.

space.notFoundNote: It may have been removed, or it isn’t open to your account.
space.loadFailed: We couldn’t load this space. Try again in a moment.

join.noteOpen: Anyone in this space’s age group can join straight away.
join.notePending: {{owner}} will see your request. You can post once you’re in.
join.noteMember: You’re a member of this space.
join.noteOtherGroup: This space takes members from another age group, so you can read it but not join.
join.noteNotActive: Your account can’t join spaces yet.

threads.membersOnly: Only members can post here. Join to start a thread or reply.
threads.membersOnlyApprove: Only members can post here. Join to start a thread or reply. The owner checks each request.
threads.readLocked: Only members can read this space’s threads. Join to read them.

rules.title: Space rules
rules.none: The owner hasn’t written any rules yet.
rules.guidelines: The community guidelines apply here too.

runs.title: Who runs it
runs.note: Our moderation team can take action in any space.

requests.title: Requests to join
requests.ageChanged: {{name}} is no longer in this space’s age group, so the request was removed.

form.title: Create a space
form.intro16: Anyone can create a space, and you become its owner. Because you’re 16 or over, your space is for members 16 and over, and anyone, with or without an account, can read it. You can change everything below later.
form.introUnder16: Anyone can create a space, and you become its owner. Because you’re under 16, your space is for members under 16, and you choose who can read it. You can change everything below later.
form.introUnknown: We need to know your age group before you can start a space.
form.logIn: Log in to create a space.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Each name can only be used once. You can name a space after a book or an author.
form.rulesHint: One rule a line. Shown at the top of your space. The community guidelines always apply as well.
form.whoJoinsText: Spaces keep age groups apart. A space started by someone under 16 takes only under-16s. A space started by someone 16 or over takes only people 16 and over.
form.whoJoinsTurning16: When a member turns 16, they stay in the spaces they joined before, but they can’t start or join under-16 spaces.
form.readersMembersNote: Only people in your space can read its threads.
form.readersEverybodyNote: Anyone can read it, but only under-16s can join or post.
form.postingAnyoneNote: Anyone in your space’s age group. Good for open discussion.
form.postingMembersNote: Readers can still read. Only members can start threads and reply.
form.notOwner: Only the owner can change this space.

newThread.heading: New thread in {{space}}
newThread.cannotPost: You can’t post in this space yet. Go back to the space to join it.

failures.not_active: Your account can’t do this yet.
failures.age_unknown: We need to know your age group before you can start or join a space.
failures.age: This space is for another age group.
failures.not_owner: Only the space’s owner can do this.
failures.owner_leaving: You run this space, so you can’t leave it.
failures.missing: This space isn’t here any more.
failures.too_many_one: You’ve done this a lot in the last hour. Try again in {{count, number}} minute.
failures.too_many_few: You’ve done this a lot in the last hour. Try again in {{count, number}} minutes.
failures.too_many_other: You’ve done this a lot in the last hour. Try again in {{count, number}} minutes.
failures.too_many_unknown: You’ve done this a lot in the last hour. Try again later.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach the server. Try again.
failures.invalid: Check the form and try again.

name.html: A name can’t hold HTML tags.
name.taken: Another space has this name. Try another.

description.taken: Another space has this name. Try another.
